title: Harbour Gazette test feed
description: Fictional stories served on 127.0.0.1 for the NEWSWIRE browser tests.

stories.title: Lighthouse keepers strike over night-shift pay in Port Ellery
stories.summary: Lighthouse keepers at three stations stopped work on Tuesday, saying their night-shift allowance has not risen in nine years.

stories.title: Lightkeepers union announces a second walkout
stories.summary: The union representing lightkeepers said talks with the harbour authority had stalled and a second day of action would follow.

stories.title: Council approves new cycle lanes for the old town
stories.summary: Councillors voted to add protected cycle lanes on four streets around the market square.

stories.title: Harbour museum reopens after two-year renovation
stories.summary: The maritime museum on the quay reopened with a new gallery about the age of sail.
